components.name: ECDSA-secp256k1 via ethers signer / injected wallet

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js (SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations) is a real transitive dependency of this build — pulled in via elliptic (used by hardhat's Ethereum tooling). Shipped in the build; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency of this Hardhat/Ethereum toolchain (pulled in via ethereumjs-util/hardhat). The build ships secp256k1 ECDSA — quantum-vulnerable under Shor. Lockfile presence is the dependency inventory; the application's own signing happens in MetaMask/hardhat, not via this library directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Locked dependency evp_bytestokey ^1.0.0 in package-lock.json, pulled in via crypto-browserify/cipher-base in the react-scripts 5 webpack toolchain. Implements OpenSSL's EVP_BytesToKey — a single-round MD5-based KDF used by the browser AES polyfill to derive key+IV from a password. Real dependency inventory; the weak KDF ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Locked dependency bcrypt-pbkdf ^1.0.0 in package-lock.json (via sshpk in the request/http-signature chain used by the react-scripts toolchain). bcrypt-based KDF used for OpenSSH private-key passphrase derivation inside sshpk. No application call site; the KDF ships in the dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA implementations (keygen, PKCS#1 encryption/signing) shipped by node-forge@0.10.0, locked in package-lock.json via selfsigned@1.10.8 in the webpack-dev-server chain. node-forge's RSA keygen is what produces the dev server's localhost self-signed certificate. Quantum-unsafe PKE in the shipped dependency tree; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Locked dependency create-ecdh ^4.0.0 in package-lock.json (via crypto-browserify, bundled by react-scripts 5 for the webpack build). Implements ECDH key agreement (crypto.createECDH browser polyfill) over named curves. Classical key agreement in the shipped tree — retroactively breakable if exercised; no direct application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signing shipped by tweetnacl@1.0.3, locked in package-lock.json (via sshpk, used for OpenSSH key operations in the toolchain). Quantum-unsafe signature scheme in the shipped dependency tree; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic 6.5.4 ships ECDSA (secp256r1/secp256k1) and ECDH to this build as a transitive dependency of hardhat's Ethereum tooling. Quantum-vulnerable signature algorithm present in the shipped node_modules.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 (Curve25519 scalar multiplication, tweetnacl.scalarMult) shipped by tweetnacl@1.0.3, locked in package-lock.json via sshpk in the react-scripts toolchain. Quantum-unsafe key agreement in the shipped dependency tree; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is Ethereum's core hash (tx hashes, addresses, ABI event topics) — @ethersproject/keccak256, keccak (native, incl. ganache-core's copy) and js-sha3 are all real shipped dependencies of this dApp's toolchain. Keccak/SHA-3 is quantum-safe as a hash; inventory-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @ethersproject/pbkdf2 is used by ethers.js for JSON keystore (v3 wallet) encryption; browserify pbkdf2 v3 comes via react-scripts/browserify transitive deps. No first-party call site sets an iteration count, so no CWE-916 input.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 locked in package-lock.json — notably a dependency of @ethersproject/json-wallets inside ethers v5, which this project depends on DIRECTLY (ethers ^5.7.0 in package.json). Implements scrypt, the memory-hard KDF used to decrypt Ethereum keystore JSON files (Web3 secret storage v3). Real dependency inventory; strong KDF, no application call site in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES block-cipher implementations shipped in node-forge@0.10.0 (via selfsigned@1.10.8 in the webpack-dev-server dev chain). Symmetric cipher — not Shor-vulnerable; part of the shipped dependency inventory. No direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes 1.1.2 is pinned in yarn.lock as a transitive dependency of the React/hardhat toolchain. Ships SHA-256 among its hash suite; quantum-safe hash, no action beyond inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes 1.1.2 in yarn.lock also provides BLAKE3. No application call site; library-level presence only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes 1.1.2 in yarn.lock also provides SHA-3/Keccak. No application call site; library-level presence only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption) shipped via tweetnacl@1.0.3 in the sshpk chain. Symmetric AE, quantum-resistant; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency recorded in package-lock.json and yarn.lock (tweetnacl ^0.14.3 and ^1.0.3, pulled in by packages like sshpk/ethers tooling); the application source has no direct import. The library ships XSalsa20-Poly1305, Ed25519, X25519, and SHA-512 implementations in the shipped dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency (node-forge@1.3.1, via webpack-dev-server → selfsigned) used by react-scripts' dev server to generate self-signed X.509 certificates for localhost HTTPS during development. Ships RSA, X.509, TLS and PKCS support in the shipped dependency tree; no direct import in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: selfsigned@1.10.8 locked in package-lock.json: generates the webpack-dev-server's self-signed X.509 localhost certificate for dev HTTPS under react-scripts 5, using node-forge RSA keygen. Dev-only, changeable here; the minted cert is a throwaway trust anchor for localhost, never shipped to production.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@0.10.0's X.509 support (certificate building/parsing) in the webpack-dev-server → selfsigned development chain; used to mint and consume the localhost dev certificate. Dev-only; no production use.
